gitCommit.subject: Redesign the public website: navy Dukan ERP hero, design system, ten-section home
gitCommit.body:
Redesign the public website: navy Dukan ERP hero, design system, ten-section home

The approved dark Dukan ERP direction, written into the real public pages:
- a design system: self-hosted fonts (Bricolage Grotesque, IBM Plex Sans and
  IBM Plex Sans Arabic, OFL), navy/amber/phone tokens with dark counterparts,
  one card, radius, shadow and motion scale; full-width bands (navy, white,
  tint) with their content constrained; navy header with a segmented language
  control and navy footer; the in-app pages stay light and plain
- home: hero with the product drawn in markup (demo values, no currency, no
  provider), three proofs in one row, what it replaces, six capabilities as a
  bento, the two activities, how it works, screen previews, three languages,
  trust, one call to action - EN/FR/AR, pre-launch wording kept
- Dukan ERP, Products, About (publisher vs product), Support, Contact and the
  legal pages on the same system; legal texts, versions and dates unchanged
- motion: one hero entrance, sections rising from a readable state (never
  hidden, 700 ms fallback), bars grow once, scan line twice; all off under
  reduced motion; no dependency, no analytics, CSP unchanged
- /fonts/* cached as immutable

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
